items.description: M5 x 0.8 x 30 mm fully threaded socket-head cap screw; Class 12.9 black-oxide alloy steel; DIN 912 / ISO 4762; head Ø8.5 x 5 mm; 4 mm hex; upright foot only
items.cost_per_unit_basis: USD per screw; pack price divided by pack quantity without rounding to cents
notes: Upright foot only: four screws through integral 10 mm total-thickness bolt seats. Main foot remains 6 mm thick.
Nominal head-to-nut-end stack: 10 mm seat + 1.2 mm H06 top washer + 6 mm supporting plate + 1 mm H03 bottom washer + 5 mm H04 nut = 23.2 mm. M5 x 30 gives 6.8 mm nominal tail beyond nut.
Inspect actual stack, full nut engagement, nylon insert engagement, thread protrusion and underside clearance. Reselect length if support-plate thickness changes.

Integral seat provides local foot stiffness; the engineering screen does not rely on the soft oversized washer to spread bending load. Do not apply full Class 12.9 screw preload to the lower-rated joint.

engineering_limits: Grade 12.9 screw designation is directly verified; catalog proof stress is not separately stated. No tightening torque supplied.

Grade 10 nuts, H03 washers listed for 10.9, H06 washers of unspecified strength grade and the aluminum female threads restrict joint preload/capacity. Full 12.9 screw capacity is not a rated assembly capacity.
All purchased dimensions and formed thread engagement must be physically inspected; film total includes adhesive in the design bound even though catalog inclusion is unclear.
No outdoor, vehicle, airborne, overhead or vibration qualification implied.
